Package com.ascend.testlab.client.postgresql.impl

Class PgReaderClientImpl

java.lang.Object
com.ascend.testlab.client.postgresql.AbstractPostgreSQLClient
com.ascend.testlab.client.postgresql.impl.PgReaderClientImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
PgReaderClient
public class PgReaderClientImpl extends AbstractPostgreSQLClient implements PgReaderClient
Implementation of the PgReaderClient interface. Uses the AbstractPostgreSQLClient to interact with the PostgreSQL database.
